$comment: The Regulation M-B preview pool: what you can expect to be looking at across the table.
This file exists because team preview is a decision under uncertainty. You see six
species and nothing else — no items, no moves, no spreads. So a species here is not one
set, it is a distribution over sets, and the shares are what make the app able to say
'this plan holds unless their Garchomp is the Scarf one (13%)'.
usage, moves, item shares  — published Champions Reg M-B ranked data (Pikalytics,
Season 3, retrieved August 2026). The percentages in each
set's note are quoted from it.
spreads                    — NOT published anywhere. Every sp block below is a reading
of what the set is for. They are the first thing to edit.
variant move lists         — where a variant changes moves (a Choice set cannot hold
Protect), the swap is inferred and the note says so.
measured:false marks a species whose set shape was never published; it gets one set and
the app labels it as a guess wherever it shows up.
Every move is checked against the real learnset at build time, so a mistake here fails
the build rather than shipping as a fake set.

sets.label: Life Orb
sets.note: The #1 Pokémon of the format. Dragon Claw 89%, Rock Slide 82%, Earthquake 81%, Protect 70%.

sets.label: Sitrus Berry
sets.note: Same four moves, points moved into bulk. Spread inferred.

sets.label: Choice Scarf
sets.note: Item share measured at 13%; the fourth move is inferred, because a Choice set cannot run Protect.

sets.label: Choice Scarf
sets.note: Last Respects 100%, Aqua Jet 95%, Wave Crash 82%. Choice Scarf 45% — the source notes the Scarf set drops Protect; the replacement is inferred.

sets.label: Mystic Water
sets.note: Protect 54%. Mystic Water 20%.

sets.label: Focus Sash
sets.note: Focus Sash 18%. Last Respects scales with how many of its own team have fainted, so the Sash set is the late-game one.

sets.label: Focus Sash
sets.note: Tailwind 99%, Moonblast 92%, Encore 74%, Protect 57%. Focus Sash 76%. Prankster 99%.

sets.label: Fairy Feather
sets.note: Fairy Feather 11% — the set that actually wants to click Moonblast. Spread inferred.

sets.label: Chople Berry
sets.note: Sucker Punch 99%, Kowtow Cleave 98%, Iron Head 74%, Protect 69%. Chople Berry 43% — it is there for the Fighting move that would otherwise end it.

sets.label: Black Glasses
sets.note: Black Glasses 32%. Same four moves, more damage, no answer to Fighting.

sets.label: Focus Sash
sets.note: Focus Sash 13%. Spread inferred: the Sash set is the one that wants the Speed.

sets.label: Sitrus Berry
sets.note: Rage Powder 99%, Matcha Gotcha 99%, Life Dew 59%, Trick Room 59%. Sitrus 35%.

sets.label: Kasib Berry
sets.note: Kasib Berry 30% — a Ghost resist berry on a Ghost type, which tells you what it is afraid of.

sets.label: Colbur Berry
sets.note: Colbur Berry 14%, for the Dark move — read: for Kingambit.

sets.label: Sitrus Berry
sets.note: Fake Out 100%, Parting Shot 97%, Flare Blitz 93%, Throat Chop 54%. Sitrus 60%. Intimidate 99.8%.

sets.label: Chople Berry
sets.note: Chople Berry 15%.

sets.label: Passho Berry
sets.note: Passho Berry 12% — it expects to be clicked on by a Water move and to live.

sets.label: Charizardite Y
sets.note: Protect 98%, Heat Wave 95%, Solar Beam 92%, Weather Ball 84%. Charizardite Y 95%. Half of the format's most common core: Mega Charizard Y + Garchomp, 20.6% of teams.

sets.label: Charizardite X
sets.note: Charizardite X 4%. Move list inferred — the X forme is physical and Tough Claws, so nothing on the Y set applies.

sets.label: Staraptite
sets.note: Close Combat 98%, Protect 90%, Brave Bird 81%, Roost 72%. Staraptite 95%. The Mega turns Intimidate into Contrary, so Close Combat raises its defences instead of dropping them.

sets.label: Floettite
sets.note: Protect 100%, Dazzling Gleam 97%, Moonblast 79%, Light of Ruin 58%. Floettite 99%. Highest win rate in the format at 54.2%.

sets.label: Fairy Feather
sets.note: Hyper Voice 100%, Quick Attack 82%, Hyper Beam 71%, Detect 61%. Fairy Feather 90%. Pixilate turns all three Normal moves Fairy and adds 20%.

sets.label: Unburden
sets.note: Close Combat 99%, Fake Out 94%, Dire Claw 94%. White Herb 71% — it undoes the Close Combat drops and, by being consumed, doubles Speed through Unburden. Unburden 56%.

sets.label: Poison Touch
sets.note: Poison Touch 43% — same set, no Speed doubling. Which ability it is changes whether it outruns you after one Close Combat.

sets.label: Sitrus Berry
sets.note: Trick Room 96%, Psychic 61%, Helping Hand 49%, Protect 39%. Sitrus 62%. Armor Tail 99.9% blocks Fake Out and every other priority move aimed at its side.

sets.label: Colbur Berry
sets.note: Colbur Berry 25%.

sets.label: Focus Sash
sets.note: Hurricane 99%, Weather Ball 88%, Tailwind 87%, Wide Guard 51%. Focus Sash 45%. Drizzle 100% — its rain makes Hurricane stop missing and Weather Ball a doubled Water move.

sets.label: Sitrus Berry
sets.note: Sitrus 31%. Spread inferred: the Sitrus set is the one that wants to be alive on turn three.

sets.label: Damp Rock
sets.note: Damp Rock 13% — eight turns of rain instead of five. If you see this one, the rain is not going to run out.

sets.label: Raichunite Y
sets.note: Fake Out 72%, Protect 66%, Zap Cannon 60%, Focus Blast 56%. Raichunite Y 61%. The Mega has No Guard, which is why a 50%-accurate Zap Cannon is on the set at all: it never misses and it always paralyses.

sets.label: Raichunite X
sets.note: Raichunite X 18%. Move list inferred — the X forme is physical.

sets.label: Focus Sash
sets.note: Focus Sash 15% — no Mega, so no No Guard, so Zap Cannon becomes a coin flip and Thunderbolt replaces it. Inferred.

sets.label: Leftovers
sets.note: Electro Shot 97%, Flash Cannon 95%, Protect 94%, Dragon Pulse 74%. Leftovers 89%. Stamina 93%. Electro Shot charges in a single turn under rain, which is why this one travels with Pelipper.

sets.label: Wide Lens
sets.note: Top-20 usage, but no published move percentages. The whole set is a reading.

sets.label: Metagrossite
sets.note: Top-20 usage; the Mega gains Tough Claws. Set shape is a reading, not measured.

sets.label: Swampertite
sets.note: Added in Reg M-B; Swift Swim on the Mega makes it the rain pay-off. Set shape is a reading, not measured.

sets.label: Light Clay
sets.note: Top-20 usage; Light Clay arrived with the Reg M-B item batch. Set shape is a reading, not measured.

sets.label: Aerodactylite
sets.note: Top-20 usage. Set shape is a reading, not measured.

sets.label: Sitrus Berry
sets.note: Appears in Reg M-B ladder data. Set shape is a reading, not measured.

sets.label: Focus Sash
sets.note: Appears in Reg M-B ladder data. Disguise means the first hit it takes does nothing, so every damage number against it is a turn late. Set shape is a reading.

sets.label: Chople Berry
sets.note: Added in Reg M-B. Set shape is a reading, not measured.

sets.label: Covert Cloak
sets.note: Added in Reg M-B. Good as Gold refuses every status move aimed at it — Spore, Will-O-Wisp, Encore, Parting Shot. Set shape is a reading.
